title: Worship
intro: Worship is at the center of our life together. Our Sunday service combines Scripture, prayer, music, preaching, and Holy Communion.

sections.heading: Sunday Worship — 10:00 AM
sections.text: Our principal weekly service is Holy Eucharist. The service follows the Book of Common Prayer and normally lasts about an hour.

sections.heading: Priest
sections.text: In the Episcopal church, our ministers are referred to as priests. Epiphany currently does not have a "regular" priest. Instead we have the next best thing - a rotation of experienced priests that conduct our services. Watch our service videos to get an idea of the variety.

sections.heading: Visitors and newcomers
sections.text: You do not need to know the Episcopal liturgy before you come. A bulletin provides what you need along with the red  Book of Common Prayer and the blue Hymnal found in the pews. You are free to participate at your own pace. We are a friendly group. Please ask someone for help if you need it.

sections.heading: Watch online
sections.text: Our Sunday service and is normally streamed online. Use the Watch on YouTube below to watch services.

sections.heading: Birthday/Anniversary
sections.text: During the service we have a special blessing for anyone celebrating a birthday or anniversary.
